Built to keep your funds safe

  1. Regulated under EU rules

    Our flagship products are UCITS approved by the French regulatory authorities. Spiko is a MiFID-authorized investment firm in France, licensed to provide brokerage services.

  2. Safe assets, bankruptcy-remote structure

    Your funds are never on Spiko’s balance sheet. They are either invested in risk-free assets (Treasury bills) or backed by the world’s largest banks, with real-time transparency of all exposures.

  3. Tier 1 partners

    We partner with the world's top asset managers (e.g., Amundi), auditors (e.g., PwC) and depositary banks (e.g., CACEIS) to build the best products.

  4. Access management and security controls

    The Spiko app lets you define multiple access levels across your organization. All critical functions are protected with 2FA, and a 'four-eyes' mode can be enabled to approve sensitive actions, such as withdrawals.

Spiko Finance is a simplified joint-stock company (SAS) with a share capital of €2,500,000 registered with the Paris Trade and Companies Register (No. 980 659 585) and headquartered at 229 rue Saint-Honoré, 75001 Paris, France. Spiko Finance is licensed as an investment firm by the French Prudential Control and Resolution Authority (ACPR) under no. 19183. Spiko Finance is also registered as an authorized banking and payment services intermediary (MOBSPL) with ORIAS under number 23008251. These regulatory authorizations can be verified at www.regafi.fr and www.orias.fr. All client funds are held by our banking partner, CACEIS Bank (a subsidiary of the Crédit Agricole group), in full compliance with current legislation. Spiko does not hold any client funds.
